purpose: Handbook page for the Getallen domain.
details: Sections: place value, rounding, divisibility (ja/nee typing), the number line (reading, pointing with zoom, jumps, temperatures) and the cheat sheet. summary: Describes place value, rounding, divisibility (typing ja or nee, divisors, primes, gcd and lcm from year 6) and the number line with four kinds of questions (reading, pointing with zooming, jumps, temperature), with tables per year.
